correctness.rationale: Original survival is exp(-x) below 1 and exp(-1-(x-1)/3) above; direct integration gives m_X=1+2exp(x-1) below 1 and m_X=3 above. Derivatives of m_X/x are strictly negative and match continuously at the switch. After conditional right truncation at T=1+3log(5/4), S_X(T)=(4/5)e^-1, h_Y(1-)=5, m_Y(1)=3-12log(5/4). Differentiating m/x using m'=h m-1 yields left derivative 11-48 log(5/4). Alternating logarithm Taylor bound log(5/4)<43/192 proves >1/4, on a nontrivial left neighborhood. Independent arbitrary-precision evaluation gives approximately 0.2891095369; exact analytic inequality is decisive. Truncation is X | X<=T, not censoring.
residual_risks: Piecewise-constant hazard has downward jump; smooth-hazard case and right censoring not covered.
